label: TP
reason: Both findings represent real vulnerabilities: (1) Insecure randomness via java.util.Random().nextFloat() generates predictable tokens used for session identification; (2) XSS occurs when cookie values (from user-controlled cookies) are concatenated directly into HTML response without encoding.

evidence.note: Weak random number generation using java.util.Random().nextFloat() produces unpredictable tokens
Unsanitized cookie values concatenated directly into response.getWriter() causing XSS
